verdict.rationale: Freshsales is a CRM with built-in Freddy AI features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no documentation of any setting or policy that keeps customer data out of model training. 'Forget a Contact' is a data-deletion API, a different control from a training opt-out, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
